framework: Next.js 16 static export with React and CSS
component_behavior: Radix primitives or carefully selected shadcn components with a custom visual layer
media: responsive images with stable dimensions, modern formats, meaningful alt text, lazy loading below the fold, and self-hosted/subset fonts where licensing allows

sources.name: Motion
sources.use: Use for purposeful React/JavaScript animation, gestures and scroll-linked sequences.

sources.name: Radix Primitives
sources.use: Use low-level accessible behavior as a foundation, then apply a project-specific visual language.

sources.name: shadcn/ui
sources.use: Use selected primitives, not an undifferentiated card-grid template or copied default theme.

sources.name: Next.js
sources.use: Use built-in image/font optimization and stable dimensions when Next.js matches the project.

sources.name: Lighthouse and Lighthouse CI
sources.use: Use repeatable mobile and desktop audits as release evidence; account for run variance.

sources.name: web-vitals
sources.use: Measure field or realistic lab evidence for LCP, INP and CLS instead of relying on visual intuition.

sources.name: Playwright
sources.use: Verify desktop/mobile framing, interaction, console/network health and nonblank 3D canvases.

install_policy: Recommend dependencies only. Never install packages or copy external assets/code without project review and an applicable license check.
